convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators. Simple crossover entry/exit with fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic (only standard Trade library for order execution). No multi-timeframe, no hedging, no partial close, no custom indicators.

other_exits: Closes buy position on bearish MA crossover (MA1 crosses below MA2)
Closes sell position on bullish MA crossover (MA1 crosses above MA2)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Allows 1 buy + 1 sell simultaneously, but blocks duplicate same-side positions when all_positions==1

custom_logic_notes: Non-standard crossover detection: compares MA1[1] (previous bar of fast MA) against MA2[0] (current bar of slow MA) rather than comparing same-bar indexes. This creates an asymmetric comparison mixing previous-bar fast MA with current-bar slow MA. The position gate logic only checks for same-side duplicates when all_positions==1, meaning if 2 positions exist (1 buy + 1 sell), the same-side check is bypassed and a duplicate could theoretically be opened, though the crossover signal would typically not fire again on the same bar due to the new bar guard.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward MA crossover EA. Two iMA handles with configurable period/method/price. Crossover uses non-standard bar alignment (MA1[1] vs MA2[0]) - replicate this exactly. No SL/TP means exits are purely signal-based (reversal close). Position check only prevents duplicate same-side when exactly 1 position exists. Use standard MA libraries (ta-lib or pandas-ta). The new bar guard means signals are evaluated once per bar, so M1 data minimum for backtesting. Market orders use current Ask/Bid at time of signal detection on new bar open.
